title: fix(app-shell): no per-predicate nav visible warning where no expression scope is mounted (Studio)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9QBZoZ4mGo9UUbkV5F38iyX)_

Fixes #25892

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Where Studio evaluates the browsed apps' navigation

Read on `origin/main` at `8a990d8b`. The `app-shell:visible` reporter is reached only through the navigation gate (`evaluateNavigationVisibility`, through `useNavVisibility` / `useNavMemberGates`). On `/studio` the one consumer of that gate is the header: `StudioLanding` (`ui/apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx`) mounts `AppHeader variant="studio"`, `AppHeader` calls `useSharedActivityFeed`, and that hook builds the bell's activity roster with `activityObjectRoster(apps, useNavMemberGates())`, walking the navigation of **every** installed app on each render (the roster is computed even before the bell is opened; only the read is deferred).

The `/studio` subtree mounts no `ExpressionProvider` (only `AppContent`, `HomeLayout`, `RecordFormPage` and `InternalFormRoute` do) and sits outside `ConsolePermissionsScope` on purpose (`studioEntry.ts`, and the `(d) CONTROL` case in `App.homePermissions-12700.test.tsx`). So `useExpressionContext()` hands the gate its no-provider default: an empty `current_user` and no permissions. HotCRM's `!("sales_rep" in current_user.positions)` faults with `No such key: positions`, and `current_user.can("crm_lead", "read")` faults because no payload is bound, which is exactly the pair of lines in the issue.

The package pillar builder (`StudioDesignSurface`) mounts none of the gate's consumers on current main (no `AppHeader`, `UnifiedSidebar`, `CommandPalette` app scope or `nav:menu` block), so on main the landing is the measured site. The issue was filed against the 18.1.0 build; if a builder page still warns there, it is through the same gate and the same fix covers it.

## Choice: the "do not judge it here" route (option a), not the rebuilt scope (option b)

- **(b) evaluate with the app shell's `current_user`** would mean mounting `ExpressionProvider` with `buildExpressionUser(user)` and a `MePermissionsProvider` around the Studio header: a change in `ui/apps/console` (outside this claim's file surface), a second `/auth/me/permissions` request on every Studio load (the entry gate already reads it without installing a context, by design), and a loading posture for the header.
- **(a)** stays inside `@object-ui/app-shell` (two files, no exported type change). A frame that mounts no `ExpressionProvider` is now known to the gate (`useHasExpressionScope`, internal), and on such a frame a predicate that cannot be answered is **withheld exactly as before, without a warning**. The verdict does not move: the bell's roster in the Studio is byte-for-byte what it was. Only the false diagnostic goes. Inside an app, where the scope is bound, a real fault is still reported once per predicate, and a blank gate is still reported on either frame.

No once-per-load note replaces the ten warnings, although triage allowed one: `ui/eslint.config.js` allows a package only `console.warn` / `console.error`, and one warning on every Studio load is the same noise in a smaller dose.

## What changed

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx`: `useHasExpressionScope()` (internal, not on the package entry); `evaluateNavigationVisibility(expression, evaluator, scopeBound = true)` withholds without reporting when `scopeBound` is false.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavMemberGates.ts`: `useNavVisibilityAndReads` passes `useHasExpressionScope()` through `navEntryVisible` (new optional last parameter, default `true`), so every navigation surface picks its frame from the mounted provider.
- `.changeset/25892-studio-nav-visible-noise.md`: `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell`.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`: not changed. `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` was run and re-recorded it byte-identical (registry sources 922 files in 27 packages, sha256 `0e127be18a11…`), so neither edited file is a registry source; `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is green on the head.

## Tests

All at head `00b69d84`.

Then, at head `25a08400`: CI's first Test UI run went red on 14 shards because 20 sidebar / layout suites `vi.mock` the `ExpressionProvider` module without the new export. `useHasExpressionScope: () => true` is added to those 20 mocks (test files only, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/*`). The 32 mock-bearing files pass locally, 136/136.

- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/__tests__/navigationVisibility.unboundScope-25892.test.tsx` (6 cases): HotCRM's two gate shapes on a frame with no scope are withheld with zero `app-shell:visible` lines; through `useNavVisibility` with no `ExpressionProvider`, the same; controls: the same predicates on a bound frame still report once each, literals / absent / evaluating predicates keep their answers, a blank gate is still drawn and reported, and under `ExpressionProvider` the signed-in user's `positions` answers while an unbound `can()` still reports.
- `cd ui && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the new file plus `navigationVisibility-12700`, `ExpressionProvider.visibleFaultDiagnostic`, `UnifiedSidebar.navCanPermissions-12700`, `sharedUserFeeds.activityRoster-12530`, `navGateUnionScope-12980` and the console's `App.homePermissions-12700`: `Test Files 7 passed (7)`, `Tests 63 passed (63)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Narrowed on purpose; the full app-shell suite is left to `Test Core`.
- Ablation (committed fix, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): replacing `if (scopeBound) reportAppShellVisibleFault(...)` with the unconditional report turns the new file red, `Tests 2 failed | 4 passed (6)` (the two "no scope" cases), then restored, blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The tests import `src` directly, so no build sits between mutation and run.
- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build && pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 34 derived commands, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, all `exit 0`; `--ran` reconciliation: `34 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)`.
- Not merged with `origin/main` before opening (the branch is at `8a990d8b`; the derivation saw no upstream commit touching what it derives); CI runs on the merge ref.

## Acceptance notes

- Other frames with an `AppHeader` and no `ExpressionProvider` (for example the organizations pages) take the same quiet path; that follows from the frame, not from a Studio special case. Not measured in a browser.
- The bell's roster is still computed on every render of `AppHeader`, before the bell is opened (only the read waits on `enabled`). That is cost, not a defect, and not changed here. Carrier: none.
